source_evidence: Completed R19: lower LUT, but main MAE/PSNR worse than serial in the three MAC cases. R20 intermediate outcomes have not been used.
research_question: Can whole-output numeric mean-error cost select better functions from the same WCE-feasible dual-LUT relation, without sacrificing area savings?

derivation.relation: Keep the existing global WCE allowed relation R_C(row).
derivation.objective: Accumulate S(row,q)=sum over reachable primary inputs in row of abs(C[q](x)-f(x)); combine across each physical shared-pin row and output role.
derivation.solver_boundary: Fixed support feasibility remains2CNF. Minimizing general pairwise costs is not plain2SAT; do not claim polynomial global optimization.
derivation.finite_candidate: For the existing support masks, retain incumbent; try cost-guided feasibility-preserving variable fixing with2SAT queries, then compare actual full-domain MAE at equal resource proxy. Preserve incumbent to avoid discarding known feasible functions.
derivation.hypothesis: Current WCE/local-HD tie selection can spend global numeric error badly. Physical-feasible numeric-cost completion may improve quality at the same LUT opportunity.
derivation.novelty_boundary: Weighted Boolean optimization, error-aware ALS, counterexamples, and2SAT are prior art. Any contribution must be the demonstrated physical-function generation capability and resource-quality frontier, not the generic optimizer.

decision_rule: Do not change R20. Consider only after all current experiments and full analysis. Require a material quality/resource gap and a fixed subsequent matrix.

tractable_subcase_to_check_after_round.known_result: Binary pairwise energy terms with E00+E11<=E01+E10 admit an s-t min-cut construction; this graph-cut theorem is prior work.
tractable_subcase_to_check_after_round.project_inference: For fixed LUT half-table support masks, aggregate global numeric SAE by the two projected Boolean variables. Enforce forbidden WCE assignments with a penalty exceeding the total feasible objective. Check whether variable polarity flips make all aggregated pair costs submodular; solve that class by min-cut, otherwise keep existing feasible assignments or use finite feasibility-guided optimization.
tractable_subcase_to_check_after_round.polarity_check: Positive/negative pair curvature imposes equality/inequality between variable polarity bits. Detect contradictions on cycles; never pretend every relation is graph-representable.
tractable_subcase_to_check_after_round.conditional_guarantee: If the checked transformed pairwise energy is submodular, min-cut is globally optimal for that fixed support/topology and objective, not for whole-circuit placed LUT count or all candidate windows.
tractable_subcase_to_check_after_round.purpose: An explicit possible route to improve arithmetic quality inside an already area-efficient feasible relation, while reporting the tractable fraction and failures.

implementation_notes_for_later_decision.objective_options: Uniform whole-domain absolute error for MAE, or squared error for PSNR/RMSE. Choose one objective before a later round; do not relabel metric choices as separate innovations.
implementation_notes_for_later_decision.numeric_safety: Squared-error accumulation must use sufficiently wide integer arithmetic, preferably unsigned128 in native context extraction, then arbitrary-precision Python capacities.
implementation_notes_for_later_decision.candidate_retention: Keep known feasible incumbent. Fixed shared pins/I5/output role and support masks first; no hidden physical-tool search. Restrict or reject candidate if gauge constraints conflict; count such cases.
implementation_notes_for_later_decision.evaluation: Both hard WCE and distributional quality; compare actual LUT/FF/CARRY/timing after export, since preserving nominal supports does not guarantee equal post-route area.
implementation_notes_for_later_decision.composition_harness: ../tools/fir_system_harness.py now prepares a standard16/32tap programmable signed16 FIR and a four-unsigned8-tile signed16 wrapper. Not run; composition is not monolithic32-input synthesis and is not a new contribution.
implementation_notes_for_later_decision.full_width_error: Each unsigned8 tile error <=B implies signed16 composition error <=66049*B, with exact signed correction and explicit no-overflow verification. FIR then has taps times the core error bound. Separate these analytic bounds from empirical application quality.
